posts.title: Start of my Youtube channel
posts.description: November 15, 2026 na magsisimula ang 'Pinoy Dark Stories with Inikozen'! Maari niyong mapanood ang aking mga kwento sa aking official Youtube channel: Pinoy Dark Stories Youtube Channel Ang aking official announcements, news, at updates ay makikita lamang sa website na ito: Inikozen Official Website For business inquiries, maaari niyo akong ma-contact sa aking contact form: Inikozen's Contact Form

posts.title: Why I created my Youtube channel?
posts.description: I created this post to serve as a reminder for me kung ano ba ang mga rason kung bakit ko ginawa ang Youtube channel kong 'Pinoy Dark Stories with Inikozen'. Ginawa ko rin ito para malaman ng mga manonood ang purpose ng bawat kwentong aking isinulat at isinasalaysay: To serve as a reminder.
